Sustainability
In Kenya, the bond selected to match the liabilities outstanding had a term of approximately 7 – 7 ½ years and with a yield
of 15.3% per annum. At this yield, the bond and the liabilities had discounted mean terms of 4.43 years and 4.62 years
respectively the yield is thus considered appropriate discount rate. In Uganda, the longest bond had an outstanding term
